name: Conrad Xiamen
insider_take: Perched along the scenic Xiamen Bay, the Conrad Xiamen is a sleek urban sanctuary where China's rich coastal culture meets world-class luxury — with some of the most breathtaking harbor views in all of Fujian Province.
whats_special: Harbor & Gulangyu Views: The hotel offers sweeping panoramic views of Xiamen Bay and the iconic Gulangyu Island — a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage Site — just moments from your window. Prime Zhenhai Road Location: Nestled along one of Xiamen's most celebrated waterfront corridors, guests are steps from upscale shopping, seafood dining, and cultural landmarks. Conrad Spa & Infinity Pool: Unwind in the stunning rooftop infinity pool or indulge in signature treatments at the Conrad Spa, designed to reflect the tranquil coastal spirit of Xiamen. Culinary Excellence: From authentic Fujian cuisine highlighting bold, umami-rich flavors to international fine dining, the hotel's restaurants celebrate the best of land and sea.
pro_tip: Request a bay-view room on a higher floor for unobstructed sunset views over Gulangyu Island — the golden hour here is truly magical and worth every penny of the upgrade.
dont_miss: Gulangyu Island Day Trip: A short ferry ride delivers you to this car-free island paradise, famous for its colonial architecture, piano culture, and charming cobblestone lanes. South Putuo Temple: One of China's most revered Buddhist temples, located just minutes away — a serene and culturally rich experience not to be skipped. Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street: Xiamen's most famous shopping and snacking boulevard, blending colonial Baroque architecture with vibrant local street food culture.
pros: Prime waterfront location with stunning harbor and city views
Exceptional service standards with personalized luxury experiences
Multiple award-winning dining venues featuring international and local cuisine
State-of-the-art facilities including spa, fitness center, and rooftop pool
cons: Located in busy commercial district with high foot traffic
